failure_summary.description: Agents imported tool functions from a nonexistent `tools` module despite the injected-tool instruction.
Agents reused an outdated or less compatible cache result, repeated an applied filter, or incorrectly returned “No planning needed” after preferences changed.
An agent invented hotel dates instead of seeking the missing dates while still completing the independent restaurant search.
An agent shortened the user-provided neighborhood value instead of preserving it.

patch.reasoning: No edits are warranted: the current skill already explicitly forbids tool imports, requires compatible cache reuse and filtering only when needed, prohibits guessing missing travel dates while allowing independent searches, and requires preserving user-provided entity values. These failures reflect noncompliance with existing guidance rather than a gap to patch.
